mapper.select: select patient_id from base_patient where concat(IFNULL(name,''),IFNULL(pinyin_name,''),IFNULL(mobile,'')) like concat(concat('%',#{combination}),'%')

select t1.* from ( SELECT DISTINCT bp. patient_id patientId, bp.NAME, bp.mobile, bpm.card_number cardNumber, bpm.member_level_name memberLevelName, IFNULL( ( SELECT principal_amount FROM base_patient_member WHERE card_opening_date = ( SELECT Max(card_opening_date) FROM base_patient_member
type = bpm.type and card_id = bpm.card_id
and date_format(card_opening_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ) <= date_format(#{form.startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d' )
GROUP BY card_opening_date ) limit 0,1 ),0 ) earlyCurrentRechargePrincipal,
IFNULL( ( SELECT bonus_amount FROM base_patient_member WHERE card_opening_date = ( SELECT Max(card_opening_date) FROM base_patient_member
type = bpm.type and card_id = bpm.card_id
and date_format(card_opening_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ) <= date_format(#{form.startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d' )
GROUP BY card_opening_date ) limit 0,1 ),0 ) earlyCurrentRechargeBonus,
( SELECT IFNULL(sum( a.principal_amount ),0) FROM base_patient_member_occur_log a
a.type = bpm.type and a.occur_type = 1 and a.card_id = bpm.card_id
and DATE_FORMAT( a.occur_date, "%Y-%m-%d" ) >= DATE_FORMAT( #{form.startDate}, "%Y-%m-%d" ) and DATE_FORMAT( a.occur_date, "%Y-%m-%d" ) < DATE_FORMAT( #{form.endDate}, "%Y-%m-%d" )
) thisRechargePrincipalAmount,
( SELECT IFNULL(sum( a.bonus_amount ) ,0) FROM base_patient_member_occur_log a
a.type = bpm.type and a.occur_type = 1 and a.card_id = bpm.card_id
and DATE_FORMAT( a.occur_date, "%Y-%m-%d" ) >= DATE_FORMAT( #{form.startDate}, "%Y-%m-%d" ) and DATE_FORMAT( a.occur_date, "%Y-%m-%d" ) < DATE_FORMAT( #{form.endDate}, "%Y-%m-%d" )
) thisRechargeBonusAmount,
( SELECT IFNULL(sum( a.principal_amount ) ,0) FROM base_patient_member_occur_log a
a.type = bpm.type and a.occur_type = 2 and a.card_id = bpm.card_id
and DATE_FORMAT( a.occur_date, "%Y-%m-%d" ) >= DATE_FORMAT( #{form.startDate}, "%Y-%m-%d" ) and DATE_FORMAT( a.occur_date, "%Y-%m-%d" ) < DATE_FORMAT( #{form.endDate}, "%Y-%m-%d" )
) thisExpendPrincipalAmount,
( SELECT IFNULL(sum( a.bonus_amount ) ,0) FROM base_patient_member_occur_log a
a.type = bpm.type and a.occur_type = 2 and a.card_id = bpm.card_id
and DATE_FORMAT( a.occur_date, "%Y-%m-%d" ) >= DATE_FORMAT( #{form.startDate}, "%Y-%m-%d" ) and DATE_FORMAT( a.occur_date, "%Y-%m-%d" ) < DATE_FORMAT( #{form.endDate}, "%Y-%m-%d" )
) thisExpendBonusAmount,
( SELECT IFNULL(sum( a.principal_amount ),0) FROM base_patient_member_occur_log a
a.type = bpm.type and a.occur_type = 3 and a.card_id = bpm.card_id
and DATE_FORMAT( a.occur_date, "%Y-%m-%d" ) >= DATE_FORMAT( #{form.startDate}, "%Y-%m-%d" ) and DATE_FORMAT( a.occur_date, "%Y-%m-%d" ) < DATE_FORMAT( #{form.endDate}, "%Y-%m-%d" )
) thisReturnPrincipalAmount,
( SELECT IFNULL(sum( a.bonus_amount ),0) FROM base_patient_member_occur_log a
a.type = bpm.type and a.occur_type = 3 and a.card_id = bpm.card_id
and DATE_FORMAT( a.occur_date, "%Y-%m-%d" ) >= DATE_FORMAT( #{form.startDate}, "%Y-%m-%d" ) and DATE_FORMAT( a.occur_date, "%Y-%m-%d" ) < DATE_FORMAT( #{form.endDate}, "%Y-%m-%d" )
) thisReturnBonusAmount,
IFNULL( ( SELECT principal_amount FROM base_patient_member WHERE card_opening_date = ( SELECT Max(card_opening_date) FROM base_patient_member
type = bpm.type and card_id = bpm.card_id
and date_format(card_opening_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ) < date_format(#{form.endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d' )
GROUP BY card_opening_date ) limit 0,1 ),0 ) currentRechargePrincipal,
IFNULL( ( SELECT bonus_amount FROM base_patient_member WHERE card_opening_date = ( SELECT Max(card_opening_date) FROM base_patient_member
type = bpm.type and card_id = bpm.card_id
and date_format(card_opening_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ) < date_format(#{form.endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d' )
GROUP BY card_opening_date ) limit 0,1 ),0 ) currentRechargeBonus FROM base_patient bp JOIN base_patient_member bpm ON bp.patient_id = bpm.patient_id JOIN base_patient_member_occur_log bpmol ON bpmol.card_id = bpm.card_id
bpm.type = #{form.type}
and bpm.org_id = #{form.orgId}
and bpm.card_number = #{form.cardNumber}
and bpm.member_level_id in
#{levelIds}
ORDER BY currentRechargeBonus DESC ) t1
and t1.patientId in
#{ids}

select bpmor.payment_id as accountItemId, bpmor.payment_manner as accountItemName, bpmor.credit_amount as totalAmount from base_patient_member_occur_log bpmor where bpmor.recharge_method = 0 -- 表示普通充值 and bpmor.occur_type = #{occurType} and bpmor.occur_log_id = #{rechargeRecordId} and bpmor.type = #{cardType}
